title: Carts expire in 30 minutes
body: A tenant may reprice a book while a shopper decides, so an expired cart is repriced, not honoured.
summary: An unconfirmed cart expires after thirty minutes so a stale price is never honoured.
quote: A cart that has been priced but not confirmed expires after thirty minutes.

title: Refunds use payment intents
body: Refunding through the intent that captured the money bounds the refund by what was captured.
summary: Refunds are issued against the original payment intent rather than as a separate bank transfer.
quote: Refunds are issued against the original Stripe payment intent rather than by bank transfer

title: Guest checkout is excluded
body: Every order belongs to an account, which is what lets a tenant say where an order is.
summary: Checkout requires an account in this release; there is no guest checkout path.
quote: Guest checkout is not in the first release.
